tasks.label: Kill Ports
tasks.command: lsof -ti:3000,5173 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; sleep 1 && echo killed

tasks.label: Check Node
tasks.command: node --version 2>&1; which node; fnm list 2>/dev/null || echo 'no fnm'; ls ~/.fnm/node-versions/ 2>/dev/null || true

tasks.label: Test fnm Node
tasks.command: eval "$(fnm env --use-on-cd)" && fnm use 25 2>/dev/null || fnm use default && node --version && cd table-serve-frontend && node node_modules/.bin/vite dev 2>&1 | head -20

tasks.label: Kill 5173
tasks.command: lsof -ti:5173 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; echo done
